2379: Risa Koizumi is not your average Japanese high school student. Risa's height is well above that of most Japanese girls her age (the average height for a female is 160 cm (5 ft 3 in) Ironically, her surname means 'little spring'. She and other characters compare her to a giraffe.
2380: Atsushi Ootani is one of the main characters. He is very short for a boy, standing 156 centimeters. Like Koizumi, Ootani's surname (roughly, "big valley") is a pun on his diminutive stature, and he can be thoughtless and rude; at heart, however, he is kind and a little silly.
2741: He's Risa's childhood friend who moved overseas while they were still in elementary school. He considers Risa a hero to him as she was the one who stood up for him when the other boys made fun of him because of his name.
3023: Fashionable and charming, Nobu is Risa's best friend. She is generally wiser than Risa or Chiharu in the ways of love, and is always ready to offer her advice.
3024: One of Risa's closest friends, Chiharu has such a shy, demure personality that she fears most boys her own age. Ootani once harbored a crush on her (she resembles Kanzaki, his ex-girlfriend), but Chiharu instead fell for the gentle Suzuki. The two are now a couple.
3025: Nobu's boyfriend. Mild-mannered and easygoing. Nakao is absolutely dedicated to Nobu, and when he is not playing basketball with Ootani, he can usually be found helping with her match-making schemes.
3026: Chiharu's boyfriend. Suzuki's cool demeanor is often mistaken for standoffishness, and so he has few friends. Oblivious to Risa's crush on him, he developed feelings for Chiharu.
3422: Has a large crush on Otani.
3423: Student teacher at Risa and Ōtani's school. Maitake, who prefers the nickname "Maity", he is 24 years old [he mentioned that in the Anime] and he is taller than Risa and extraordinarily good-looking. He soon acquires a legion of female fans.
3424: A popular rap group. Risa and Otani are both avid fans of the eponymous lead singer, Umibouzu, leading to Nobu's suggestion that the two are compatible.
3425: She is the ex-girlfriend of Ootani. She looks very similar to Chiharu (or Chiharu to her), which is one the most likely reasons that Ootani had that crush on Chiharu. They started dating in middle-school, and she was the manager for the school basketball team.
4614: Ootani's next door neighbor. She is in love with Ootani, and brings him milk every day so he could reach her height, about the same as Risa's. Since Ootani does not not have feelings toward her but he does have feelings for Risa, Mimi becomes jealous of her.
4881: A young student who works part time with Risa in Ikebe. He is notably shorter than her, although slightly taller than Otani (158 cm.), and has distinctive black hair with a red streak. Risa soon discovers that he is also an avid Umibouuzu fan.
46831: She appears in the last episode as the stylist of Mimi.
47435: Risa's younger brother and main character in the Lovely Complex Deluxe one shot and Lovely Complex Two.
